import Mathlib

open Set

noncomputable def seqLimsup (u : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf (Set.range fun n : ℕ => sSup (u '' Set.Ici n))

noncomputable def seqLiminf (u : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (Set.range fun n : ℕ => sInf (u '' Set.Ici n))
